column1: # p476 depth probe of openeducat/openeducat_erp, 2026-10-27. Closes Gap 475-N (SPLIT_SCOPE declared but not
# enumerated) and addresses Gap 475-G's depth blind spot. Instrument: shallow clone (git clone --depth 1) at
# HEAD 46a5d7d400820d471b67b8c019997bfa5d3c873e, which equals the ls-remote HEAD read on the raw channel --
# two independent channels agreeing on the same HEAD. The GitHub REST API is 403 for non-session repos here,
# so the tree could not be walked over HTTP; the clone is what made depth reachable.
# FINDING: SPLIT_SCOPE is DECLARED in the root payload but NOT INSTANTIATED anywhere in the tree.
# Licence files at ANY depth in the 17 MB tree: exactly 1 (the root LICENSE, 8241 B, digest 528f84036800,
# byte- and digest-identical to p475's read). Modules carrying terms other than LGPL-3: 0 of 14.
